name: Five9
description: Five9 is a cloud contact-center-as-a-service (CCaaS) platform for inbound, outbound, and blended customer engagement across voice and digital channels, built around its Genius AI suite of AI Agents, Agent Assist, and GenAI Studio.
best_for: Contact centers wanting published bundle pricing plus a dedicated Genius AI product line (AI Agents, Agent Assist, AI Summaries) for automating routine customer interactions.
features: Omnichannel engagement across voice, email, chat, social, and SMS/video
Genius AI suite: AI Agents for customer interactions, Agent Assist, AI Summaries and Insights, and GenAI Studio for building custom AI experiences
Agent Desktop and Supervisor tools for managing live interactions
Workforce engagement and quality management tools
CRM and unified-communications (UC) integrations plus APIs/SDKs for workflow automation
99.999% uptime reliability, per Five9's own site
pros: Publishes real per-seat bundle pricing (Digital and Core) rather than requiring a quote to see any number
Genius AI is packaged as a distinct, named suite (AI Agents, Agent Assist, GenAI Studio) rather than a single generic AI feature
cons: Published Digital ($119/seat/month) and Core ($159/seat/month) bundles require a minimum of 50 seats; Plus, Pro, and Enterprise bundles require contacting sales
Five9 cites a customer case study reporting 80% intent-matching accuracy from its AI Agents -- a specific customer's result, not a guaranteed platform-wide figure

tiers.name: Digital Bundle
tiers.notes: Digital channels only (chat, email, SMS/MMS, social messaging). Priced per concurrent user; minimum 50 seats; usage-based pricing may apply.

tiers.name: Core Bundle
tiers.notes: All channels including voice, with essential AI features included. Minimum 50 seats; usage-based pricing may apply.

tiers.name: Plus / Pro / Enterprise Bundles
tiers.notes: Contact sales for flexible, custom pricing.

alternatives.name: Genesys Cloud CX
alternatives.description: An enterprise contact-center-as-a-service (CCaaS) platform unifying contact center, digital channels, workforce engagement, and AI orchestration across voice and digital customer interactions.
alternatives.best_for: Large enterprises wanting a single platform for contact center, digital channels, and workforce management, with published per-user pricing across four tiers.
strengths: AI Experience tokens bundled per tier for orchestrated AI agents
Broad enterprise integration ecosystem (Salesforce, ServiceNow, AppFoundry)

alternatives.name: Talkdesk
alternatives.description: A cloud contact center platform combining traditional contact-center software with autonomous, orchestrated AI agents for specific customer-experience tasks.
alternatives.best_for: Contact centers wanting published per-agent pricing tiers plus a no-contract small-business plan alongside Five9.
strengths: Published per-user pricing from $85-$225/month across four tiers
Talkdesk Express: 25 licenses plus $100 credit with no contract, for businesses under 50 employees
Autonomous multi-agent AI orchestration for specific CX tasks

alternatives.name: RingCentral
alternatives.description: A cloud communications platform (RingEX) that also offers RingCX, an omnichannel AI-powered contact center, alongside its core phone, video, and messaging suite.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting contact-center capability bundled inside a broader unified-communications platform rather than a dedicated, standalone CCaaS product.
strengths: RingCX omnichannel contact center with AI-powered quality management
Published per-user pricing from $20-$35/month for the core UC suite

faq.question: Is there a minimum number of seats to buy Five9?
faq.answer: Yes. Five9's published Digital and Core bundle prices apply per concurrent user with a minimum of 50 seats; usage-based pricing may also apply on top of the per-seat rate.
